post_image_policy: use the current user post catalog first for lifestyle content after semantic matching by season, scene, environment, temperature, expression, action, props and copy context; product and trial copy uses current approved formal DM/products-v3 first; when a suitable user ZIP source exists but its binary is not online, keep needs_binary_sync and do not regenerate; only a true no-match may request regeneration; any generated, replaced or edited content invalidates prior approval, returns to pending_review and must pass the 16-item review gate
guard_policy: validate the current authority, actual binary availability, formal specs and required capabilities; compare post-media behavior to post_catalog/post_approval_batch instead of retired ZIP names, fixed counts, old version numbers, retired filenames or previous wording
